text_block_list.text:
An unexpected entry into the Satsuki Sho, 
the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown. 
Meisho Doto falls into an utter panic.

Her classmates, T.M. Opera O and Admire 
Vega, are in full-on serious mode, but—

Making getting used to the atmosphere her 
top priority, Meisho Doto decided to 
follow T.M. Opera O around.
